review: Optional openidconnect 4.1.0 client uses rsa only for public RS256 signature verification via CoreJsonWebKey/RsaPublicKey::verify. OidcProvider exposes no RSA private-key signing or decryption; client authentication uses HTTP Basic. Test token signing uses jsonwebtoken/ring. Re-review before introducing private-key operations or changing this dependency path.

rsa_key.rs uses RSA only for generation, PKCS#8 decoding/encoding and public n/e extraction. Private-key signing uses ring; no RSA decryption is exposed. Optional IAM oidc-sessions additionally reuses the reviewed framework openidconnect 4.1.0 public RS256 verification path, with no RSA private-key operations. Re-review before adding private-key operations through rsa.
